name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Gaza's civil defence says Israeli fire killed four on 21 Nov, three in a strike on a food-aid vehicle
state: Gaza's civil defence said Israeli fire killed four people on 21 Nov, three in a drone strike on a vehicle carrying food aid in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa; the Israeli military said it struck militants there (RTÉ/AFP; Al-Monitor). The Gaza health ministry says more than 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire. With hostilities in Gaza and the wider war with Iran continuing, the Alert holds.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon and the Gulf, which advises against travel to several areas.
rubric_hit: Repeated ceasefire breaches and regional war = Alert
